review_locator: PMCID:PMC7605919, GM-CSF: A Promising Target in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
primary_title: Epigenetic and transcriptional regulation of IL4-induced CCL17 production in human monocytes and murine macrophages
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-4 upregulates IRF4 expression in human monocytes and murine macrophages as part of the pathway leading to CCL17 production.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-4-associated IRF4 gene-expression bridge upstream of CCL17 output; preserve the STAT6/JMJD3/IRF4 context and do not treat IRF4 as a terminal target.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7605919, GM-CSF: A Promising Target in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
primary_title: Epigenetic and transcriptional regulation of IL4-induced CCL17 production in human monocytes and murine macrophages
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-4-induced CCL17/TARC mRNA in human monocytes and murine macrophages, with STAT6 and IRF4 dependence in the tested systems.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-4-to-CCL17/TARC gene-expression bridge; keep it distinct from the separately materialized CCL17 protein-release node and preserve myeloid context.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7605919, GM-CSF: A Promising Target in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
primary_title: Epigenetic and transcriptional regulation of IL4-induced CCL17 production in human monocytes and murine macrophages
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-4-induced CCL17 protein in supernatants from human monocytes and murine macrophages, measured by ELISA and reduced by IRF4/STAT6/JMJD3 perturbation.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-4-to-secreted CCL17 protein-release bridge; preserve distinct gene-versus-protein semantics and do not infer an unqualified downstream CCL17 receptor edge or SCI relevance.
